newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan-Nov operational deficit at 3.91 pct/GDP.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan-Nov operational deficit at 3.91 pct/GDP.

text.p: Brazil's operational deficit in the January to November period was 3.91 percent of gross domestic product, slightly lower than the 4.01 percent of GDP shortfall registered through October, the Central Bank said.

The operational deficit includes interest payments on government debt. The primary deficit, a narrower measure which does not factor in interest payments, was in equilibrium in the period, the bank said in a statement.
